title: Tart Strawberry Shortcake
description: A classic dessert featuring tart strawberries, juicy shortcake, and a hint of herbal sweetness.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press mixture into a 9-inch round baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly golden.
In a separate bowl, whip tart cream until stiff peaks form. Fold in herbal honey.
Split shortcake into slices and layer with sliced strawberries and whipped cream.
If desired, drizzle with berry jam.
